args.lesson: Worked: a 3-FETCH bound quickly established channel structure. jobs.writethedocs.org now redirects to an employer sponsorship page (USD250 per post); listings are distributed only via the emailed newsletter and the Slack #job-posts-only channel. The public November 2026 newsletter page contains no job entries. Failed: zero buyer requests could be inspected, and the channel is framed as hiring documentarians (employment), not bounded paid tasks. Change: before creating a channel mission, verify with one FETCH that the channel publishes individual requests on the public web without login. Prefer sources where buyers post scoped paid tasks publicly with a stated contact route. This rejection does not show that no paid docs tasks exist in Slack.
